On Planet, complete one suggested objective at a time. Its button opens the relevant screen; you confirm every purchase yourself.
Zetanie: szybkie floty. Automatony: recy: Zetans: fast fleets. Automatons: material recycling. Symbionts: ship replication. Each race has its own buildings and research.
Zwykły kryształ służy do budowy. Ule Roj: Ordinary crystal is used for construction. Swarm hives regenerate 1 rare crystal every 18 hours once their defenses have recovered. All attackers share the same stock. Loot arrives when your fleet returns.
Każdy zakup w kole podnosi ceny pozostał: Every skill wheel purchase raises the price of remaining skills, including other branches. Choose your path carefully: completing the whole wheel is extremely difficult.
Rój umacnia nieliczne ule. Zrób zwiad i: The Swarm fortifies a small number of hives. Scout and coordinate raids with other players. An empty vault yields no crystals. The Swarm can occupy up to 8 planets and occasionally sends escorted transports to raid player supplies, even when free planets remain.
Sprawdź przeciwnika, ustaw liczbę statkó: Scout your opponent, choose your ships, check the route and tap Send. The red ATTACK panel shows the threatened colony and arrival time.
Każda planeta ma własne zasoby i wspólną: Each planet has its own resources and one shared queue for buildings, ships and research. Switch planets at the top. Tap Planet again to scroll to the top.
